en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a steamship with the name 'VISBY' visible on its hull. The vessel is seen from the deck of another ship, with a large naval gun in the foreground. The Swedish flag is visible at the stern of the steamship, and there are people on the deck. Printed text in Swedish at the lower left reads 'Svensk konvoj,' indicating a Swedish convoy.
